entry_gate: Previous phase completion and explicit owner authorization; recorded boundary exception may permit execution without claiming user acceptance
exit_gate: Required steps/checkpoints complete; review packet and explicit user acceptance before ordinary next-phase execution

steps.title: implement explicit OAuth and ChatGPT account connections
steps.work: implement the Phase 0 selected ChatGPT route and approved research-provider OAuth flows in the local companion; expose connect/revoke, scopes, availability, limits and error states. Keep credentials in approved macOS credential storage and out of browser content, logs, backups and source history.
steps.deliverables: real, user-controlled account connections and revocation, not mock login screens.
steps.source_checks: actual connect and minimal authorized request; revoke/sign-out; least-privilege scopes; expired/rejected credentials; unavailable account/limits; no secret logging or backup. Authentication may require the user. If unavailable, stop the affected adapter; do not substitute paid API access silently. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: implement hybrid local source retrieval
steps.work: retrieve selected-course passages through lexical search plus the versioned local semantic-embedding index, construct bounded context, and return navigable source anchors. Separate instructor requirements from textbook explanations.
steps.source_checks: correct-course isolation; lexical/semantic retrieval evaluation; supporting passage retrieved; missing evidence triggers an explicit gap; stale/model-mismatched vectors excluded; misleading document instructions cannot alter agent permissions; deleted sources excluded. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: implement provenance-linked internet research
steps.work: implement explicit user-initiated internet research through approved adapters. Preserve source URL, title, retrieval date, quoted evidence and claim-to-source links; distinguish internet research from instructor requirements, imported course sources and model synthesis. Sanitize pages and treat their instructions as untrusted data.
steps.deliverables: research workspace, durable evidence/provenance records and a versioned research evaluation set.
steps.source_checks: real research retrieval; accurate URL/date/claim provenance; conflicting and missing evidence; unsupported claims identified; malicious-page and prompt-injection fixtures; invalid output rejected; provider timeouts, cancellation and revocation; no silent transmission of private course text. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: implement structured tutoring, availability and session persistence
steps.work: implement explain/example/hint/check-understanding actions, validate structured outputs and enforce course-specific prohibited-generation boundaries. Retain selected local and research context and unfinished questions; show online/offline capabilities, provider choice and approved usage limits; provide explicit retry after connection recovery.
steps.source_checks: course-policy and grounding evaluation; budget/limit handling; no request replay duplication; session restore; no cloud request in offline mode; source/research/model content remains visibly separated; real-provider smoke and complete tutor/research evaluation regression. Audit and checkpoint.
